title: 68% of Workers Are One Injury From Losing Everything
hook: You insure your car, your phone, even your pet — but 68% of workers have zero protection against the #1 cause of personal bankruptcy.
angle: Disability insurance is the single most neglected financial product. You're 7x more likely to become disabled than to die during your working years, and most workers have no idea their short-term plan runs out after 6 months.
audience: Full-time workers aged 25-50 who assume they're covered through work or Social Security and have never checked their long-term disability status
key_numbers: 68% of private-sector workers have no long-term disability coverage
1 in 4 workers will be disabled before retirement
Average disability lasts 34.6 months — nearly 3 years
$165,000 in lost wages for a $55K salary over 3 years
Long-term disability policy costs just 1–3% of annual salary ($50–$150/mo)
